Definition: properly, to tread or frequent; usually to follow (for pursuit or search); by implication, to seek or ask; specifically to worship
BiblicalUsage: To seek is the great verb of the spiritual life, and it appears over a hundred and fifty times. The prophets cry seek the Lord and live, the kings enquire of Him before battle, and the psalms promise that those who seek Him will not lack any good thing. Seeking is not a single prayer but a way of life: to frequent God's presence until it becomes home.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe seeking is the whole of the Christian life in one word. I hold that God is not hiding from us; He has promised that those who seek Him with all their heart will find Him, and the finding is worth the search.
